title: Eli Goldston Professor of Business Administration Chair, OPM
bio: - WINNER OF THE "NATIONAL INDIE EXCELLENCE AWARD" FOR BEST SCIENCE FICTION (2021). - Currently in development as a TV Series. The book's many themes—war & peace, history, strategy, negotiation, leadership, friendship, & love—are woven together in a novel with a sci-fi hook and a thrilling premise. The protagonist is a young history professor who is whisked off to Washington, where he discovers that he'll need to use all the skills and knowledge he has acquired in his life to help save humanity from a conflict of truly historic proportions. The book is meant to be a page-turner, with many twists & turns, but embedded throughout the novel are some genuinely cerebral elements: lessons and insights on strategy, history, negotiation, war & peace, and the human condition.
